papers.title_en: SGAR: Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction via Sparse Geometry-Guided Attention
papers.authors: Aoxiang Fan, Maria Pilligua, Corentin Dumery, Oliver Heinimann, Pascal Fua
papers.evidence: 前馈多视图三维重建采用稀疏几何引导注意力
papers.tldr: 前馈式三维重建依赖跨视图注意力，但让所有图像块彼此交互会使计算量随视图数平方增长，限制大规模应用。SGAR借鉴运动恢复结构中的几何匹配思想，以轻量模块预测跨视图图像块的三维邻近关系，并用少量相关块构成稀疏注意力。实验显示，在1000个视图时它较稠密注意力最高快12倍，同时保持稳定位姿精度；在稀疏方法中准确度最佳，并能以相同时间重建更完整几何。该方法可通过微调用于不同前馈模型，为扩展重建规模提供高效方案。
papers.abstract_en: Feed-forward models have been very successful in 3D reconstruction with ad hoc attention designs that relate all view patches densely. However, the cost of this dense global attention grows quadratically with the number of views, preventing the model from applying to larger-scale reconstruction settings. In this paper, we argue that most dense attention computations are unnecessary from a classical structure-from-motion perspective: 3D structures stem from geometrically matching regions in 2D. We bring this principle to learning-based feed-forward reconstruction with our Sparse Geometric Attention Reconstruction (SGAR) method. In SGAR, each patch token attends to only a small set of patch tokens from other views, chosen by a lightweight learned key selection module trained to predict cross-view 3D proximity of tokens. Thus, dense global attention is replaced by much more efficient geometric-similarity-guided sparse attention. SGAR is a general method that can be applied to different feed-forward models by fine-tuning. In our experiments, we show that SGAR is the fastest among both state-of-the-art dense and sparse methods and the most accurate sparse one. It runs up to 12-times faster than dense attention at 1,000 views with stable pose accuracy where existing sparse methods fail, and shows the best performance in reconstructing more complete geometries on the same time budget.

papers.title_en: MAWAM: A Multi-Agent World-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
papers.authors: Xianzhe Fan, Chi-Pin Huang, Fu-En Yang, Jing Wang, Yecheng Wu, Yu-Cheng Chou, Johan Bjorck, Linxi "Jim" Fan, Jan Kautz, Yu-Chiang Frank Wang, Zhiding Yu, Hengshuang Zhao, Zhiqi Li
papers.evidence: 多机器人协同操作并联合预测动作与未来环境状态
papers.tldr: 协同操作中，每台机器人的动作都会改变队友所处的环境，因而需要同时预测团队动作及其共同创造的物理未来。MAWAM从预训练单机器人世界—动作模型出发，通过跨机器人注意力联合生成各机器人的动作片段和未来视图，同时保留独立控制接口。它在三项真实机器人任务上取得67.8%的平均成功率，比同数据训练的MA-VLA高18.9个百分点；模拟八项任务平均成功率达90.3%，团队最多包含四只机械臂。消融实验进一步显示，跨机器人注意力与团队阶段未来视频监督对协调表现都有明显贡献。
papers.abstract_en: Every move in a robot team changes the world in which its teammates must act. Coordinated manipulation therefore calls for predicting the team's actions together with the physical future they jointly create. We introduce MAWAM, a multi-agent world-action model that jointly generates each robot's future views and executable action chunks in a single sample. Built from a pretrained single-robot world-action backbone, MAWAM jointly denoises all robots' action and future-view tokens through cross-agent attention, while preserving a separate control interface for each robot. MAWAM achieves the highest success on all three real-robot tasks (laundry-bag collection, bath-towel folding, and umbrella handover), with 67.8% mean success, 18.9 percentage points above MA-VLA trained on the same demonstrations and cameras. In simulation, MAWAM reaches 90.3% mean success on eight tasks with teams of up to four arms. Ablations show that cross-agent attention and team-stage future-video supervision both improve coordinated control: without attention, a four-arm relay falls from 95.0% to 39.0%, and without this supervision, Place Food falls from 78.0% to 47.0%.

papers.title_en: Bridging vision-language reasoning and learned control for legged navigation in the wild
papers.authors: Takahiro Miki, Robin Schmid, Manthan Patel, Turcan Tuna, Julia Richter, Julian Nubert, Joonho Lee, Matthias Müller, Marco Hutter
papers.evidence: 腿式机器人结合场景语义推理、运动控制与局部规划进行实地导航
papers.tldr: 在山地、城市等开放环境中，四足机器人导航既要理解语义与风险，也要应对复杂地形并稳定运动，单一感知或控制难以胜任。ROAM将视觉语言模型的常识推理、标志解读与风险评估，转为语义标签及导航代价，再经开放词汇分割生成实时风险图，条件化仿真强化学习训练的运动与局部导航策略。实测中机器人可在多类真实环境自主完成公里级行走、识别危险标志并寻找安全落脚区域，人工干预较少。工作展示了高层语义推理与低层学习控制协同的可行性，同时指出视觉语言模型的可靠性和空间推理仍限制野外部署。
papers.abstract_en: Autonomous navigation in diverse real-world environments remains one of the greatest challenges in robotics. It demands both robust low-level motion control to handle diverse terrain and high-level reasoning to interpret environmental cues. We present ROAM (Robust Open-world Autonomous Mobility), a system that enables legged robots to perform kilometer-scale navigation in complex alpine and urban settings. ROAM combines the world knowledge of a Vision-Language Model (VLM), pre-trained on internet-scale data, with robust locomotion and local planning policies learned in simulation via reinforcement learning (RL). The VLM provides common-sense reasoning and semantic interpretation of the scene, assessing risks, interpreting signs, and producing semantic labels with associated navigation costs. An open-vocabulary segmentation module converts these labels into a dense, real-time risk map, which conditions two pre-trained RL policies responsible for agile locomotion and local navigation, effectively coupling high-level VLM reasoning with low-level physical control. Real-world experiments showed the system's ability to autonomously navigate a wide range of complex real-world environments. The robot completes kilometer-long hikes with minimal intervention, interprets signs to avoid danger, and evaluates its environment to identify safe areas on which to step. This work represents a step toward the reliable deployment of systems in unstructured environments. However, it also underscores the challenges that remain in VLM reliability and spatial reasoning, indicating that foundational models are a crucial component but not yet a complete solution for navigation in the wild.

papers.title_en: WEVO: World Model-Enabled VLA Optimization for Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation
papers.authors: Qianzhong Chen, Muyuan Lin, Yuyin Sun, Mac Schwager, Cheng-Hao Kuo, Roberto Martín-Martín
papers.evidence: 世界模型闭环训练人形机器人全身移动与操作策略
papers.tldr: 人形机器人视觉语言动作策略可通过强化学习超越模仿，但真实探索存在安全风险，仿真训练也可能利用仿真与现实的差异。WEVO先用仿真操作和移动数据改善视频世界模型，再以每项任务20次真实自主轨迹对齐部署观测，并将策略、全身控制器与世界模型构成带稠密进度奖励的闭环训练环境。在三项真实任务中，游玩数据提升所有评估的世界模型指标；模型内强化学习成功率由初始23.3%升至75.0%，高于真实机器人强化学习的48.3%。这表明仿真适合提供初始化与覆盖，部署对齐的视频模型适合进一步优化，二者互补能更安全有效地提升全身移动操作能力。
papers.abstract_en: Reinforcement learning (RL) can improve vision-language-action (VLA) policies beyond imitation, but humanoid exploration is unsafe and simulator RL can exploit residual sim-to-real gaps. We present WEVO, a teleoperation-free framework for post-training a whole-body humanoid VLA in an action-conditioned video world model (WM). Simulated manipulation and locomotion play data improve contact-dynamics and viewpoint-change prediction. A VLA trained on synthetic demonstrations collects 20 autonomous real robot rollouts per task to align the WM with deployment observations. The VLA, whole-body controller (WBC), and video WM then form a closed-loop RL environment with dense progress rewards. Across three real robot tasks, play data improves every evaluated WM metric and downstream policy success; video WM RL raises mean success from 23.3% to 75.0%, compared with 48.3% for real robot RL. We therefore leverage the complementary strengths of both environments: simulation provides policy initialization and broad coverage, while the video WM offers a deployment-aligned environment for policy improvement. Project website: https://qianzhong-chen.github.io/wevo.github.io/.

papers.title_en: MoRE: Mixture-of-Experts for Multi-Physics Robotic World Models
papers.authors: Ziyu Zhu, Shaowei Liu, Albert J. Zhai, Henry Che, Wei-Chiu Ma, Shenlong Wang
papers.evidence: 预测机器人动作引发的物理变化并用于模型预测控制
papers.tldr: 机器人世界模型需预测机器人动作与物理规律共同作用下物体的演化，但现有三维模型难以统一处理不同交互带来的异质动力学。MoRE将交互划分为刚体、可变形与抓取相关动力学，并为各类状态配置专门运动专家，构成混合专家三维世界模型。模型以仿真与真实数据混合训练，并接入模型预测控制（MPC）执行多种操作任务。实验显示，MoRE跨物理状态的预测更准确，真实场景中的MPC表现更强，为统一建模多物理机器人操作提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: A robotic world model should predict how objects evolve under robot actions and physical dynamics. While recent 3D world models have shown strong predictive capabilities, they still struggle with the heterogeneous dynamics arising from diverse object interactions. To address this in a unified framework, we decompose robotic interactions into distinct physical regimes and assign each to a specialized motion expert. We introduce MoRE, a 3D world model with a mixture of motion experts organized around rigid, deformable, and prehensile dynamics. This design enables a single model to capture diverse physical behaviors while preserving regime-specific priors. Trained on mixed simulation and real-world data, MoRE integrates with Model Predictive Control (MPC) to support diverse manipulation tasks. Experiments show that MoRE improves prediction accuracy across physics regimes, leading to stronger real-world MPC performance. Code, data, and project website are available at https://alwaysleepy.github.io/MoRE-WM-site/.

papers.title_en: SceneAnything: Agentic Reconstruction of Large-Scale Mesh Scenes from a Single Video
papers.authors: Bowen Xue, Saeed Hadadan, Fabrice Rousselle, Zahra Montazeri, Ravi Ramamoorthi, Milos Hasan
papers.evidence: 从视频重建大型网格场景，并结合深度和分割估计
papers.tldr: 从单段视频重建大型可编辑三维网格场景，既要还原可见结构，也要合理补全未拍到的表面；直接让智能体生成场景程序，常出现布局、尺度和光照错误。SceneAnything以共享相机、深度与分割估计约束场景规划和组件建模，并按可见性与拟合效果选择细节层级，对未见区域补全且标记为推断。系统拟合光照、支持运动，通过程序检查和独立视觉比较迭代，并复用已验证程序与经验。在100个场景评测中，其原视角保真度优于直接智能体重建，新视角内容相似度高于所比较的视频转三维方法，形成自动化、可复用的重建流程。
papers.abstract_en: Reconstructing an editable 3D scene from video requires matching visible structure while plausibly completing unseen surfaces. Agents can write scene-construction programs, but direct reconstruction attempts often produce errors in layout, scale, and lighting. We introduce SceneAnything, an automated system for reconstructing mesh scenes from real and generated videos, enabling text-to-scene construction when paired with video generation. A software harness coordinates agents, pretrained vision models, and graphics tools through an explicit reconstruction protocol. Shared camera, depth, and segmentation estimates ground component construction: a scene-owner agent plans the environment and briefs authors, who write parameterized Blender programs. A visibility- and fit-based level-of-detail rule selects the construction level, while unseen regions are completed and marked as inferred. Assembled scenes use fitted lighting and supported motion, and revisions undergo programmatic checks and independent visual comparisons. Accepted programs and lessons are reused across scenes. We evaluate on 100 scenes; subset comparisons show improved original-view fidelity over direct-agent reconstruction and higher novel-view content similarity than the compared video-to-3D methods. We will release the harness, agent instructions, reusable libraries, and scenes.

papers.title_en: Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies: Spatializing Latent Action Representations for Goal-Pose-Free Mobile Manipulation
papers.authors: Siyuan Zheng, Zhong Cao, Henry X. Liu
papers.evidence: 联合学习机器人移动导航与物体操作
papers.tldr: 移动操作的成败取决于机器人相对目标物体的姿态和具体任务，但联合训练移动与操作耗费数据和算力，预设导航目标位姿也难以适配操作需求。M4M从预训练操作策略的动作生成网络提取隐层表征，并结合少量执行结果，学习可估计候选位置操作成功率的空间嵌入。它将该能力用于导航训练，并学习移动到操作的切换时机。在未见厨房的八项任务中平均成功率达47.0%，显著超过最强基线的26.5%及直接操作的19.2%，表明可借助既有操作策略实现更灵活的任务感知移动操作。
papers.abstract_en: The success of manipulation policies is closely tied to the spatial relationship between the robot and the target object, as well as the task being performed, making the ability to adjust the robot's pose critical for successful execution. When the robot starts away from the task, such adjustments require coordinating navigation with local manipulation. Jointly training these capabilities incurs substantial computational and data costs, while navigating toward a predefined goal pose limits the flexibility needed to adapt to task-specific manipulation requirements. To address these challenges, we propose Learning to Move from and for Manipulation Policies (M4M), a framework that learns manipulation-aware mobility directly from pretrained manipulation policies. By leveraging the hidden representations of the policy's action-generating network as dense supervision, together with a limited number of manipulation execution outcomes, we learn a spatially conditioned embedding that captures task-dependent manipulation success across candidate robot poses. From the robot's current stereo observations, this representation estimates manipulation success at unvisited poses without rolling out the manipulation policy at each location. It is further integrated into navigation policy training, while a learned handoff policy decides when to transition from navigation to manipulation, enabling the robot to move and manipulate in a unified, task-aware manner. Across eight articulated-object tasks in unseen RoboCasa kitchens, M4M achieves 47.0% mean task success, compared with 26.5% for the strongest baseline and 19.2% for direct manipulation execution, and refrigerator-closing experiments show consistent improvements across four frozen manipulation policies.

papers.title_en: Watertight Mesh Optimization of Textured Objects
papers.authors: Nathaniel Burgdorfer, Philippos Mordohai
papers.evidence: 直接优化水密三角网格并进行自适应重网格化以改善表面重建
papers.tldr: 从图像重建高质量三维资产时，现有方法常在新视角外观、几何精度与表面质量之间取舍，也容易忽略网格本身的质量。MODL直接在封闭三角网格上联合优化几何和视角相关外观，结合拉普拉斯预条件顶点更新、曲率自适应重网格与多视图归一化互相关约束，且无需分割、几何监督或透明度混合。在物体重建数据集上，其新视角合成表现具竞争力，同时得到几何准确、网格质量更优的模型。该方法展示了直接网格优化统一逼真渲染、几何重建与实用资产制作的潜力。
papers.abstract_en: When reconstructing high-quality 3D assets from images, existing approaches often excel at one objective while compromising another, and frequently overlook the intrinsic quality of the reconstructed surfaces. We present MODL, a framework that jointly optimizes geometry and view-dependent appearance directly on a watertight triangle mesh. Our approach combines Laplacian-preconditioned optimization for smooth vertex updates with curvature-adaptive remeshing to preserve fine details and well-shaped triangles. The triangle mesh is optimized subject to multi-view normalized cross-correlation constraints, but without segmentation, geometric supervision or alpha-blending. Evaluations on object reconstruction datasets demonstrate that MODL achieves competitive novel-view synthesis while producing geometrically accurate models with superior intrinsic mesh quality. Our results highlight the potential of direct mesh optimization to unify photorealistic rendering, geometric reconstruction, and practical 3D asset creation.

papers.title_en: TuringPAI: A Foundation for On-Device Physical AI
papers.authors: Qiman Wu, Hanlin Chen, Yuhua Wei, Mingyuan Wang, Shaman Tang, Minghao Li, Rui Xin, Xingye Liu, Zhichao Yang, Yiqi Yu, Hongyan Pei, Xiaowen Tian, YingYing Liu, Shiwen Liu, Jiahui Hu, Yizhao Wang, Yuheng Zhang, Anhua Liu, Yue He, Shuang Su, Da Zhu, Hua Zhou, Pengfei Diao, Haojie Yang, Weichao Huang, Hang Zhang, Honggou Yang, Xianming Liu
papers.evidence: 物理AI模型将空间感知与观测转化为机器人操作动作
papers.tldr: 物理智能需要模型理解空间关系与动态环境，并把视觉观察转化为行动，但车载和机器人设备的算力有限，部署受到约束。论文提出TuringPAI系列，以0.65B参数的TuringPAI-VL为共享视觉语言基础，通过多尺度潜在查询整合空间特征与观测历史，并支撑自动驾驶和机器人操作模型。实验显示，视觉语言模型的几何感知优于Qwen2-VL-2B；驾驶模型在Orin-X上以12赫兹生成轨迹，操作模型在LIBERO四套任务中平均成功率达96.8%。该工作验证了共享模型基础在多种物理智能任务中的端侧应用潜力。
papers.abstract_en: Physical AI requires models that understand spatial relationships and dynamic environments and translate observations into actions under limited onboard compute. We present TuringPAI, a family of models for on-device Physical AI comprising TuringPAI-VL for shared vision-language understanding, TuringPAI-Drive for autonomous driving, and TuringPAI-Embodied for robotic manipulation. TuringPAI-VL is a 0.65B model built on HybridViT-MLQ, which combines convolutional local aggregation with Transformer-based global modeling. Multi-scale Latent Queries integrate spatial features and observation history within the same visual Transformer, providing a compact, structured interface to the language model. Training combines general vision-language data with geometric, cross-view, and temporal supervision. TuringPAI-VL supports general multimodal understanding and improves quantitative geometric perception over Qwen2-VL-2B, while providing a shared initialization for the two downstream VLA models. For autonomous driving, TuringPAI-Drive maintains all evaluated ADE/FDE metrics within 1.2\% of a full-token HybridViT baseline using the MLQ interface and achieves comparable aggregate scores in an in-house simulation evaluation. Using XPeng Native Runtime (XNRT) on a single NVIDIA Orin-X SoC, TuringPAI-Drive generates trajectories at 12\,Hz in on-vehicle operation. For robotic manipulation, TuringPAI-Embodied achieves a 96.8\% average success rate across the four LIBERO suites. These results demonstrate a shared vision-language foundation for driving and robotic manipulation under practical on-device constraints.

papers.title_en: Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking: Memory-Guided Adaptive Reasoning for Embodied Navigation
papers.authors: Weile Gong, Zijian Lu, Jiahao Zheng, Bo Xu, Yiping Zuo, Jiajia Guo, Xin He, Weijun Wang, Weibei Fan
papers.evidence: 面向具身导航，以视觉记忆和控制反馈决定动作执行与刷新时机
papers.tldr: 多模态基础模型推动具身导航发展，但频繁调用视觉语言模型会带来显著计算开销。CHAC提出免训练的记忆引导自适应推理：根据保留的视觉上下文、完成线索和控制器反馈，决定缓存航点执行多久后再更新预测；收到停止请求时，还可依据局部访问历史进行有限修正。实验中，两个基准的模型调用分别减少33.4%和64.7%，成功率分别下降0.63和10.82个百分点，且单位调用的导航表现提升。四项实机任务中，CHAC成功18次，高于原生执行的14次，并减少54.9%的模型调用和49.7%的推理时间，体现了效率与实用性的改进。
papers.abstract_en: Multimodal foundation models are advancing embodied navigation, but frequent inference incurs substantial computational cost. We present Cognitive-Horizon Action Chunking (CHAC), a training-free framework for memory-guided adaptive reasoning with a frozen navigation policy. Retained visual context, completion cues, and controller feedback determine the cognitive horizon, or how many cached waypoints the robot executes before refreshing its prediction. At the policy's stop request, local visitation history guides a bounded correction with at most one extra movement and no additional model calls. CHAC reduces vision-language model calls by 33.4% on HM3D-OVON and 64.7% on R2R-CE, with success-rate decreases of 0.63 and 10.82 percentage points, respectively. Success rate and success weighted by path length improve per model call on both benchmarks. Across four physical navigation tasks with 40 runs per method, CHAC achieves 18 successes versus 14 for native execution, reducing model calls by 54.9% and GPU inference time by 49.7%.

papers.title_en: A$^2$-VLA: Adapting Vision-Language-Action Policies to New Tools through Agentic Affordance Discovery
papers.authors: Chenyuan Zhou, Chaoyi Huang, Zibo Wang, Zhiyuan Li, Yong-Lu Li
papers.evidence: 具身智能体在模拟场景中发现工具可供性并调整操作策略
papers.tldr: 形状各异的工具可能完成相似任务，但迁移操作技能不能只复用轨迹，还需理解工具几何与任务功能的关系，并调整操作方式。A²-VLA让具身智能体在演示重建的仿真场景中提出、测试和修正功能区域及几何特征假设，积累可复用的提取技能，再将编码特征作为π₀.₅的条件输入。该方法在仿真跨工具轨迹重定向中达到86.1%的成功率，在三项真实机器人任务上较π₀.₅提升30.7个百分点。结果说明，主动发现并验证工具可供性能够支持策略适配未见工具。
papers.abstract_en: Tools with different shapes can have similar functions, but transferring manipulation skills across tools requires understanding how tool geometry relates to the specific task and adjusting the manipulation strategy accordingly. The key challenge is to discover the common affordances that contribute to task completion across different tools and verify whether they support new tools in performing similar work. We present A$^2$-VLA, a tool-adaptation framework that combines an embodied agent with a VLA policy. It treats tool affordances as hypotheses the agent can construct, test, and revise. Given teleoperated demonstrations with a few source tools, the agent reconstructs the scenes in simulation and autonomously determines task-relevant affordance features: functional regions and their key geometric properties. It develops affordance-extraction skills and refines both the features and skills through autonomous experiments in the reconstructed scenes. Validated extraction skills accumulate in a reusable skill library for unseen tools. Finally, A$^2$-VLA uses encoded functional-region features as conditioning inputs to a $π_{0.5}$ backbone during training and inference. Evaluation examines affordance reliability in reconstructed scenes and real-robot task success on unseen tools. Our method achieves 86.1% success in simulated cross-tool trajectory retargeting based on affordances. On three real-robot tool-use tasks, A$^2$-VLA improves task success by 30.7 percentage points over $π_{0.5}$.

papers.title_en: Agentic Scaling of Embodied Tasks in Simulation for Synthetic Data Collection and Policy Evaluation
papers.authors: Kang Wang, Xiaolei Zhou, Xiaoyu Wu, Zhendong Wang
papers.evidence: 在模拟环境中扩展具身交互任务并评估机器人策略
papers.tldr: 具身交互数据扩展需要大量可执行任务，但逐项设计、配置与验证成本高，制约仿真数据采集和策略评估。论文提出 AgenticTask，在人类意图约束下复用交互结构生成任务变体，并根据验证反馈修订配置；执行代理据此选择机器人技能并检查完成条件。在 RoboCasa 上，20,323 次构建尝试保存 16,450 个任务，吞吐量为每小时 166.97 个，62.26% 通过物理检查；执行代理完成约 38% 的评估任务。该框架展示了任务集扩展效率与初步执行能力，也指出可靠性、动作选择和任务兼容性等改进方向，为后续具身数据收集提供基础。
papers.abstract_en: Scaling embodied interaction data requires a broad collection of usable tasks, yet specifying and validating each task instance remains costly. We present AgenticTask, an agent-based framework that expands existing task collections under human intent. Its central representation links interaction requirements to object and part bindings, scene and robot configurations, initial conditions, and completion criteria. A task-generation agent reuses interaction structure to construct supported variations and revises incompatible configurations using validation feedback. A task-execution agent uses the same bindings and geometric records to select robot-supported skills and check completion against the original task criteria. On RoboCasa, the framework builds the AgenticTask collection, saving 16,450 task instances from 20,323 construction attempts at a throughput of 166.97 saved instances per elapsed hour, with 62.26% of construction attempts passing the configured physical checks. The execution agent completes approximately 38% of evaluated tasks, with successful cases spanning object placement, articulated manipulation, and sequential arrangement. Diagnostic analysis identifies improvement priorities in construction reliability, action selection, task-robot compatibility, and runtime integration. Together, these results demonstrate task-collection expansion with measured construction productivity and concrete execution evidence, providing a foundation for subsequent interaction-data collection for embodied AI.

papers.title_en: Reasoning on Call: Efficient Agentic Robot Control for Long-Horizon Robot Manipulation
papers.authors: Zilang Cen, Chao Tang, Fangcheng Liu, Weishi Mi, Wei Hao, JiaYu Xu, Dehao Huang, Yehui Tang, Xiaohui Cui, Tingguang Li, Xiaoyuan Zhang
papers.evidence: 面向机器人长时程操作的具身控制与任务执行
papers.tldr: 长时程机器人操作可借助多模态模型，但频繁调用推理智能体会带来明显延迟与令牌开销；发生错误时，还需判断问题源于执行还是子任务规划。RoC通过在线任务状态监视器融合时序视觉观察与有序交互记忆，预测当前子任务进度及后继任务，并按事件触发智能体审核，协调修复执行和修订计划。RMBench上，RoC较强智能体基线成功率提高24.0个百分点、令牌消耗降低65.3%，较强策略基线成功率提高15.1个百分点。三项真实机器人长时程任务进一步验证其效果，说明按需推理可兼顾操作效率与错误恢复能力。
papers.abstract_en: Large multimodal models can support long-horizon robot manipulation, but frequent model calls incur substantial latency and token costs. The central challenge is determining when agent assistance or intervention is needed and whether errors require correcting robot execution, subtask planning, or both. To address this problem, we propose RoC (Reasoning on Call), an efficient framework that coordinates a low-level policy and a high-level reasoning agent through an online task-state monitor. The monitor combines temporal visual observations with ordered interaction memory to jointly estimate progress within the active subtask and predict its successor. These predictions guide event-triggered agent review for coordinated execution repair and plan revision. Verified outcomes govern memory updates and subtask transitions, allowing routine execution to remain with the policy while reasoning focuses on decisions requiring additional assessment. On RMBench, RoC improves task success rate by 24.0 percentage points and reduces token consumption by 65.3% compared with the strongest agent-based baseline. It also outperforms the strongest policy-based baseline by 15.1 percentage points in task success rate. Real-world experiments further validate its effectiveness across three long-horizon manipulation tasks. Overall, RoC supports efficient agent intervention and coordinated recovery across execution and planning for long-horizon robot manipulation.

papers.title_en: Alignment Drives Reuse: Learning Generalizable Robot-Use Agents from Heterogeneous Experience
papers.authors: Ziyue Wang, Yaopeng Yang, Liyi Zhou
papers.evidence: 对齐不同机器人具身与交互经验以学习操作技能
papers.tldr: 视觉语言模型具有跨任务泛化能力，但机器人操作经验常因机器人形态、任务定义、几何约定与动作接口不同而彼此割裂。UniCraft统一场景坐标、感知控制接口和任务格式，让不同基准与机器人的交互反馈共同改进共享技能库及其编排策略，且不需示范或更新模型权重。实验交错使用三个基准、六种机器人，每个模型收集2700条学习轨迹；在未见任务和场景上，三个基准的成功率均有提升。冻结技能还能零样本迁移至四种新机器人和五个额外模型，表明对齐异构经验有助于构建可复用、可扩展的操作技能。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-language models (VLMs) demonstrate broad generalization across tasks and domains. However, comparable generalization in robot manipulation remains challenging. Heterogeneity in robot embodiments, task formulations, geometric conventions, and action interfaces fragments interaction experience across benchmarks and hardware. We rethink robot skill learning through alignment: Can heterogeneous interactions across benchmarks and embodiments jointly improve one shared skillset for robot manipulation? We propose UniCraft, a framework for learning robot manipulation skills by aligning heterogeneous settings. Specifically, UniCraft represents observed scene geometry using consistent coordinate conventions and aligns sensing and control interfaces across robots. It organizes tasks from different benchmarks in a canonical format, allowing interaction feedback to jointly refine shared skills and the orchestration policy that guides their selection and composition, without any demonstrations or model weight updates. We interleave tasks from 3 benchmarks and 6 embodiments, collecting 2,700 learning rollouts per agent model. During training, UniCraft improves pooled task success on unseen scenarios and tasks by 9-28 percentage points on LIBERO-PRO, 10.8-13.3 on RoboTwin 2.0, and 3.1-14.4 on RoboCasa365 (Epochs 1-3). After training, with the learned skills frozen, UniCraft demonstrates zero-shot transfer across 4 new robot embodiments and 5 additional agent models on robosuite and RoboDojo.

papers.title_en: Awaken-HI: Scaling Humanoid Intelligence with Whole-Body Human Experience
papers.authors: EngineAI
papers.evidence: 训练人形机器人通过视觉语言动作模型执行全身移动操作
papers.tldr: 人形机器人要承担家庭与工作场所的日常任务，但现有第一视角视频缺少同步全身动作，限制了移动与操作技能的规模化学习。研究构建Awaken-Human，配对约5万小时立体视频与全身动作，覆盖百余项技能，并以共享动作专家联合预测人类动作和机器人动作。实验显示，人类预训练数据越多，机器人动作预测误差越低；经T800适配后，八项真实机器人任务平均成功率达93.75%，且优于GR00T N1.7和π0.5。该方法还可泛化到未见物体及熟悉物体与新目的地的组合，为利用人类经验扩展人形智能提供了实证。
papers.abstract_en: A central goal of humanoid robotics is for robots to perform the everyday work people do in homes and workplaces. Existing egocentric video datasets cover many of these activities but provide little synchronized whole-body motion data for learning loco-manipulation at scale. We build Awaken-Human, which pairs approximately 50,000 hours of egocentric stereo video with synchronized whole-body human motion and covers more than 100 skills. Building on this, we also introduce Awaken-HI (Humanoid Intelligence), a vision-language-action model for humanoid loco-manipulation that jointly predicts original human motion and retargeted robot actions through a shared action expert. We show that loco-manipulation skills transfer more effectively from people to humanoids when human trajectories directly supervise the shared action expert. Increasing human pretraining data reduces held-out robot action prediction error according to an empirical scaling law and raises the mean success rate on downstream real-robot tasks. After full-corpus pretraining and T800 adaptation, Awaken-HI achieves a mean success rate of 93.75% across eight individual tasks and outperforms GR00T N1.7 and $π_{0.5}$ in both individual and long-horizon evaluations. The same policy generalizes to objects unseen during robot post-training and to new pairings of familiar objects and destinations.

papers.title_en: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
papers.authors: Yuzhi Huang, Jie Wu, Fanding Huang, Junchao Lin, Weichen Zhang, Ziyi Xiong, Yang Li, Zhengwei Xie, Zhimin Wang, Zhen Liu, Jiazhen Huang, Yuzheng Zhang, Yuche Liu, Hongyi Yang, Chen Tang, Shixiang Tang, Hakan Aktas, Adam Wu, Duo Wu, Kangye Ji, Shuzhao Xie, Huanan Liu, Weijue Bu, Chenxin Li, Xinyuan Wang, Tianyi Bai, Yinan Mao, Jiawei Wang, Minglei Li, Heng Yu, Ehsan Adeli, Minchen Li, Yong-Lu Li, Cengiz Öztireli, Huazhe Xu, Chao Yu, Jing Zhang, Shanghang Zhang, Weitao Zhou, Wenwu Zhu, Cheng Chi, Jingyan Jiang, Zhi Wang
papers.evidence: 评测具身智能中的推理、物理操作与环境反馈协同
papers.tldr: 机器人要可靠完成复杂操作，既需依据历史观测推理，也需精准及时地执行，还要根据环境反馈把两者连成闭环；现有基准难以区分这些环节各自及组合上的短板。论文提出 Mind2Act World，涵盖五类应用的30项仿真操作任务，并设置三档难度、干净与随机场景，以 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三种视角进行诊断。评测中最强系统在三种视角的成功率依次为52.7%、39.0%和12.0%，显示单项能力难迁移到闭环任务。基准还可归因失败并生成系统画像，指出通过环境反馈融合推理与执行仍是具身智能的核心难题。
papers.abstract_en: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.

papers.title_en: PhyDEX: A Benchmark for Physical Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models via Dynamic Extrinsic Dexterity
papers.authors: Hao Vo, Taisei Hanyu, Yuki Ikebe, Pham Tri Quang, Sreevenkata Anjani Tishita Godavarthi, Nghi D. Q. Bui, Daniel Sonntag, Chase Rainwater, Duy Minh Ho Nguyen, Anh Nguyen, Ngan Le
papers.evidence: 机器人依据质量、质心和摩擦推断完成动态投掷操作
papers.tldr: 视觉—语言—动作模型虽已快速发展，但现有基准主要评估夹爪与物体接触，难以判断模型是否真正理解重力、摩擦、惯性和质量分布。PhyDEX以动态外在灵巧性为切入点，要求机器人估计物体物理属性并将其抛向运动学工作空间之外的目标。基准包含9项任务、100个场景和3.5万条自动生成轨迹，覆盖多类物体与静态、移动目标。三种受测模型成功率均低于3%，提供真实物理属性后成功率约翻倍，真实机器人实验也发现相似问题；该基准有望推动具备物理基础的机器人策略研究。
papers.abstract_en: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have advanced rapidly in language-conditioned robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks mainly evaluate gripper--object contact and largely ignore how objects interact with the environment through gravity, friction, inertia, and mass distribution. As a result, it remains unclear whether current policies truly understand physics or merely interpolate from their training data. We address this gap through the lens of dynamic extrinsic dexterity and introduce PhyDEX, a throwing benchmark in which a robot must infer an object's mass, center of mass, and friction to send it to a destination beyond its kinematic workspace. PhyDEX contains 35K trajectories (143 hours) across nine tasks and 100 scenes, covering uniform, irregular, and dynamic-mass objects with static, multiple, and moving destinations. All data are generated by a scalable, fully automatic pipeline that combines grasp generation, motion planning, and closed-loop throw optimization under randomized physical properties. We evaluate three representative VLAs, GR00T N1.7, DynamicVLA, and ForceVLA, and find that all achieve success rates below 3\%. Our analysis reveals two key bottlenecks: limited robustness of pretrained models, which causes most failures before the throw, and physical blindness, as providing ground-truth physical properties roughly doubles success. Experiments on a humanoid robot and in the real world show the same failure patterns. We hope PhyDEX will drive the development of physically grounded robot policies.

papers.title_en: Reference-Free Humanoid Skateboarding via Termination-Shaped Reinforcement Learning
papers.authors: Ganeshvar Soenessardien, Michael Przystupa, Kevin Sebastian Luck
papers.evidence: 通过身体与滑板的交互学习机器人运动技能
papers.tldr: 人形机器人研究已在行走和跑步方面取得进展，但与被动外部物体协同的运动仍具挑战；滑板任务尤其要求机器人协调身体、地面与可移动滑板。本文提出无模型深度强化学习框架，不依赖人工示范或解析转向模型，并将任务奖励与限制不良行为的终止条件结合。训练中各类约束的触发情况变化，隐式推动策略从控制站姿发展到持续的人—板协同运动。该方法可用于K1等人形机器人学习滑板，为无需先验数据的物体介导运动提供了新路径。
papers.abstract_en: Humanoid locomotion research has advanced rapidly on walking and running, but \emph {object-mediated} locomotion, in which a robot must coordinate its body with a passive external object, remains difficult. One challenging task is skateboarding, which requires simultaneous interaction with the ground and a passive but movable platform to achieve forward motion. Current methods for tackling skateboarding with humanoid robots either require human demonstrations or utilise analytic steering models that require system identification. In this paper, we introduce a deep reinforcement learning framework that does not rely on prior data such as demonstrations and enables robots such as the K1 humanoid to learn to skateboard using model-free learning. The method combines task rewards with exploit-blocking terminations. We introduce a number of constraints restricting behaviours such as losing the planted board foot, standing with both feet on the board, excessive twisting, separation from the board, and unstable board motion. Their changing prevalence during training produces an implicit progression from stance control towards sustained robot--board locomotion.

papers.title_en: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
papers.authors: Peiyun Hu, Marko Mihajlovic, Lyndon Duong, Lahav Lipson, Wei Dong, Amaël Delaunoy, Stephan R. Richter, Vladlen Koltun
papers.evidence: 从图像和视频预测高分辨率度量深度
papers.tldr: 单目深度估计需要从图像或视频恢复稠密度量深度，但现有方法往往难以兼顾边界清晰与时间稳定：多帧方案偏重一致性，单帧方案偏重锐利度。Depth Pro 2 训练一个可扩展的统一网络，既处理单张图像也处理视频，并以原生分辨率预测深度图。论文报告，该模型同时具备度量准确、边界锐利和时间一致等特性，且在这些方面超过此前方法。作者还发布模型系列，覆盖准确性、锐利度、一致性与运行时间的不同权衡，提供新的帕累托前沿。
papers.abstract_en: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/

papers.title_en: Lift, See, Act: Hierarchical Robot Policy Pretraining with 3D Foundation Models
papers.authors: Yiyuan Ge, Changxing Ding, Ziyu Hao, Zijie Zheng, Xiangmin Xu
papers.evidence: 将人类视频提升为稠密三维表示以预训练机器人策略
papers.tldr: 利用人类视频预训练机器人策略有助于提升泛化，但无标注视频缺少显式动作监督；现有方法常只保留三维手部轨迹，忽略轨迹提取时获得的细粒度信息。LSA提出“提升、感知、行动”三阶段框架：融合多个三维基础模型的中间表征，并以深度图重建和手部区域线索引导学习。实验显示，该方法在多种仿真与真实任务上显著优于现有先进方案，操作表现稳健且准确。其贡献是把稠密三维表征和空间交互指导纳入策略预训练，拓展了从人类视频学习机器人操作的途径。
papers.abstract_en: Robot policy pretraining based on human videos is crucial for improving the policy's generalization ability. One main challenge for this task is the lack of explicit action-relevant representations in such unlabeled data. Recent works tend to estimate 3D hand motion trajectories from videos using 3D foundation models (3D FMs). However, they keep solely the sparse trajectories as supervision, ignoring the rich, fine-grained information produced during the trajectory extraction process. To address this issue, we propose LSA, a hierarchical robot policy pretraining framework that includes three phases: Lift, See, and Act. Specifically, the Lift phase elevates 2D video observations into dense 3D representations by adaptively aligning features in the policy's shallow layers with the intermediate representations extracted from multiple 3D FMs. Building upon these lifted representations, the See phase equips the policy with explicit geometric and interactive awareness through dual guidance. It introduces depth-map reconstruction to help the model comprehend 3D spatial layouts and utilizes hand region cues to explicitly supervise the encoder's attention toward task-relevant interaction hotspots. Empowered by the dense 3D representation learning and precise spatial guidance, our policy achieves robust and accurate robotic manipulation in the Act phase. Extensive experiments on diverse simulation and real-world tasks demonstrate that LSA significantly outperforms current state-of-the-art approaches. The project page is available at: https://yiyuan00.github.io/Lift-See-Act.

papers.title_en: WTR-Drive: World-Task Decomposition with Structured Risk Supervision for End-to-End Driving
papers.authors: Haoyu Xing, Shaobing Ding, Guanglei Zhao, Guanhua Zhao, Nawu Peng, Mingyang Hou
papers.evidence: 联合场景感知、未来运动预测与端到端驾驶规划
papers.tldr: 端到端驾驶规划中的候选条件场景预测可能缺少跨轨迹共享的对象参照，而汇总评分也未揭示违规对象与发生时刻。WTR-Drive将共享世界状态估计与候选条件任务推理分开，并为碰撞和碰撞时间违规加入对象关联及首个违规时间分箱监督。它在NAVSIM navtest的v1、v2专家帧序列评测中分别取得94.66和88.24分，较已发表Drive-JEPA高0.96和0.44分。候选分析还显示，最佳候选得分提升并不保证最终选中的轨迹更优，凸显候选质量与选择效果之间的差距。
papers.abstract_en: Proposal-conditioned scene predictions can lack a common object-level reference across candidate trajectories. Aggregate planning scores also leave the objects and times associated with violations implicit. We present WTR-Drive (World-Task-Risk Driving), a Drive-JEPA-based planner that separates shared scene estimation from proposal-conditioned reasoning. A proposal-independent World Memory estimates object states, map structure, and future motion by re-reading the original visual features at each refinement round. Proposal feedback updates a residual Task branch without writing back to World Memory. This branch guides refinement through candidate-specific retrieval and gated visual feedback. A final Task readout supplies candidate-conditioned features for scoring. We derive structured risk targets from existing candidate-scoring rollouts without additional simulator calls. For at-fault collision and time-to-collision violations, the targets encode event existence, association with shared object slots, and the first violation time bin. On the NAVSIM navtest split, WTR-Drive achieves 94.66 PDMS on v1 and 88.24 EPDMS on v2 (expert-frame sequential evaluation). These scores are 0.96 and 0.44 points above the published Drive-JEPA values, respectively. Candidate-level analysis shows that higher best-candidate scores can coexist with lower selected-trajectory scores, revealing a gap between candidate quality and selection effectiveness.

papers.title_en: What the Averages Hide: Monocular Metric Depth Models Still Fail in Everyday Scenes, Mostly on Scale
papers.authors: Hualie Jiang, Yujie Luo, Ziyang Song, Ximeng Li, Zhiqiang Lou, Rui Xu
papers.evidence: 评估单目度量深度模型在真实日常场景中的尺度误差
papers.tldr: 单目度量深度模型常以跨数据集平均分评估，但平均值掩盖了严重错误图像的比例、尺度偏差方向，以及不同模型是否在相同图像上失效。作者提出逐图评估框架，将度量失败率、尺度对齐后的结构表现、对齐尺度误差与跨模型共享失败分开分析，并测试11种架构的18组设置。实验覆盖7个日常场景基准、共4,406张图像；最佳设置仍有7.7%的失败，失败样本中78.8%结构完好，尺度校正后98.3%不再失败。共享失败集中于部分数据集，研究据此建议报告失败率并按失败模型数量分层，突出尺度仍是主要难点。
papers.abstract_en: Zero-shot monocular metric depth models are evaluated by averaging metric and scale-aligned scores across datasets. Averages cannot show how many images still have severely wrong metric depth, whether depth is under- or overestimated, or whether different models fail on the same images. We propose an evaluation built on per-image results: the failure rate (metric $δ_1$ < 0.5); scale-aligned metrics for structure, and the bias, dispersion and absolute error of the alignment scale for scale; and a cross-model comparison that separates shared from model-specific failures. We apply it to 11 recent architectures with and without ground-truth intrinsics (18 model evaluations) on the 7 everyday-scene benchmarks (4,406 images) used by MoGe-2. Metric depth estimation is not solved in everyday scenes, and the remaining difficulty is mainly scale: the best of the 18 evaluations still has a failure rate of 7.7% (datasets weighted equally); pooled over all failures, 78.8% have intact structure, and after scale correction 98.3% no longer fail. Images failed by at least 6 architectures make up 7.3% of the data, concentrated on HAMMER and DIODE; even when selected only by architectures of other families, they hold 34% to 40% of the error of the top 6 models, against 14% to 18% for as many random images from the same datasets. Adding objects reduces the scale error of most models; ground-truth intrinsics and, in most families, larger models reduce the failures but do not remove them. We recommend reporting failure rates, structure and scale separately, and results stratified by how many models fail. We will release the code, the per-image results with shared-failure labels, and two diagnostic sets built from TUM RGB-D.

papers.title_en: AI-Native Industrial Control Systems: An Agent Architecture for the Control System Lifecycle
papers.authors: Lisi Liu, Ang Zhou, Chuan Pang, Feng Gao, Shengkai Liu
papers.evidence: 实体机器人与摄像头智能体协作完成感知、控制和工业任务
papers.tldr: 工业控制系统正引入人工智能用于感知、控制与工程，但控制功能和运行环境往往预先固定，难以随任务变化。论文提出由协作智能体驱动的原生智能控制架构，在资源与权限约束内确定任务所需能力、构建应用并准备执行环境。物理分拣工作站试验展示了在树莓派上构建分拣应用、由边缘视觉加入检测并支持选择性分拣。结果证明了按任务构建和演进的可行性，也揭示设计追溯、职责遵循、诊断推理及物理行为验证仍待加强。
papers.abstract_en: Industrial control systems increasingly use AI for perception, control, and engineering, while available control functions and execution environments are typically established in advance. This paper proposes an AI-native industrial control system in which collaborating agents determine the capabilities required by a task, construct the control application, and prepare its execution environment. System-level agents coordinate device-level agents within configured resource and permission constraints. A physical sorting workstation illustrates two forms of adaptation. In the first case, controller and robot agents construct a sorting application on a prescribed Raspberry Pi target. In the second, a camera agent adds inspection on an edge node, and the controller associates inspection results with downstream pickup decisions. A subsequent revision enables selective sorting using the same agents and deployment arrangement. The trials demonstrate the feasibility of task-driven construction and evolution on the workstation. Commissioning also reveals limitations in the traceability of design decisions, adherence to delegated responsibilities, diagnostic reasoning, and verification of physical behavior.

papers.title_en: Hierarchical Spatiotemporal World Modeling with Content-Adaptive Spatial Addressing
papers.authors: Tiantian Li, Junfeng Lu, Yifei Wang, Zhaoyang Zhang, Lei Wang, Tianyi Qian
papers.evidence: 分层空间记忆建模部分可观测环境
papers.tldr: 在部分可观测环境开展长时程世界建模时，定位误差会不断累积，记忆既要紧凑又需保留空间结构。研究提出HiSTFormer，以分层局部时间旋转位置编码和多周期空间旋转位置编码组织信息，并用内容条件化地址偏移适应空间寻址；固定容量记忆使键值存储与逐步注意力开销不随序列增长。它在MemoryMaze与HM3D上优于强基线，且对远超训练长度的预测时域泛化更好。结果表明，这种时空层次组织与自适应寻址可为高效长时程预测提供有效归纳偏置。
papers.abstract_en: Long-horizon world modeling in partially observable environments requires compact memories that preserve spatial structure despite accumulated localization drift. Inspired by hippocampal episodic and spatial memory and the multi-periodic coding of entorhinal grid cells, we propose HiSTFormer, a hierarchical spatiotemporal world model, which adopts a layer-wise organization of local temporal RoPE and multi-periodic spatial RoPE, together with content-conditioned address offsets, to capture recent temporal context and long-range spatial structure. A fixed-capacity memory keeps KV storage and per-step attention cost bounded as the sequence grows. On MemoryMaze and HM3D, HiSTFormer outperforms strong world-model baselines within the training sequence length and generalizes substantially better to prediction horizons far beyond those seen during training, while using a compact model. The hierarchical spatiotemporal design remains effective across deeper Transformer stacks, with consistent gains as depth increases. These results show that hierarchical spatiotemporal organization and content-adaptive spatial addressing provide effective inductive biases for efficient long-horizon world modeling.

papers.title_en: World-delta: Continually Integrating Observations for Incremental 3D Scene Generation
papers.authors: Haonan Wang, Hanyu Zhou, Xiaobin Hu, Luxin Yan
papers.evidence: 通过不确定性感知世界模型持续整合观测并修正三维场景
papers.tldr: 现有三维生成通常依赖固定输入，难以随着新观测持续扩展和修订场景；把生成结果与真实观测合并为既定结构，还可能使早期错误不断累积。World-delta维护区分观测支持内容与暂定补全假设的持久世界状态，并依据新证据产生局部差分。系统用差分掩码引导扩散，只重生成需要更新的区域，冻结未变部分并整合受影响的三维块。实验显示，该框架支持增量扩展和观测驱动纠错，在场景一致性与更新效率方面表现有效，为持续构建可修订的三维世界提供了方案。
papers.abstract_en: Existing 3D generation methods synthesize visually compelling scenes from fixed inputs, yet struggle to continually expand and revise a 3D world as new observations arrive. Iterative approaches often fuse real observations and generated content into a single representation, treating generated content as established structure rather than revisable predictions. Consequently, early generation errors can persist and accumulate despite new evidence. We propose World-delta, an incremental 3D scene generation framework combining uncertainty-aware persistent world modeling with delta-guided diffusion for continual scene expansion and correction. Our framework comprises three components: 1) Visual Evidence Encoding integrates geometric and semantic cues from incoming images into unified world tokens. 2) Observation-Calibrated World Modeling maintains a persistent latent world state that distinguishes observation-supported content from provisional completion hypotheses. New evidence drives selective world deltas to revise conflicting hypotheses while preserving well-supported content. 3) Incremental World Diffusion Generation uses delta-derived masks to restrict diffusion to regions requiring updates, freezing unchanged regions. Only affected 3D chunks are decoded and integrated into the existing scene. Together, these components enable continual world expansion and revision while reducing redundant generation and preserving scene consistency. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of World-delta in incremental 3D scene generation, observation-driven correction, scene consistency, and update efficiency over successive scene updates.

papers.title_en: GaussTrans: A Gaussian Interface Framework for Multi-Layer Refractive Transport
papers.authors: Zixuan Zhao, Tao Wang
papers.evidence: 多层透明场景的隐式表面建模与重建
papers.tldr: 多层透明场景的表面重建需同时处理界面几何、折射光路与观测结果误差；层数增多后误差相互耦合，使简化层数或光路的方法难以适用。GaussTrans提出面向高阶透明场景的紧凑光传输框架，融合高斯表面与隐式场建模不同界面，并围绕完整光路联合细化。它还利用基元支持区域辅助隐式求交，降低界面与射线交点误差。在RefRef等数据集上，该方法取得显著更高精度且空间存储需求较低，为多层折射介质建模提供了有效方案。
papers.abstract_en: We investigate surface modeling of multi-transparent interfaces to achieve accurate light transmission. The interplay of errors in geometric structure, light paths, and observation results during the reconstruction of transparent media with a high number of layers makes this a challenging problem. Some existing techniques address the reconstruction of transparent scenes by reducing the number of layers or simplifying light paths; however, this limits their direct applicability to high-order transparent scenes. We propose GaussTrans, a compact framework for light transport in high-order transparent scenes, consisting of three components: Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces, Transport-Coupled Refinement, and Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection. Gaussian-Field Hybrid Surfaces use a hybrid approach combining Gauss surfaces and fields to reconstruct different interfaces. Transport-Coupled Refinement reduces coupling errors by evaluating the entire light path. Primitive-Guided Implicit Intersection combines primitive support regions to reduce errors in the intersection of interfaces and rays. In experiments on datasets such as RefRef, GaussTrans achieves significantly higher accuracy with relatively low spatial storage requirements.

papers.title_en: Less Than Meets the Eye: Action-Set Identifiability and Principled Abstention for 3D Physical Geometry
papers.authors: Reshad Ul Karim, Abrar Samin, Sammam Mahdi, Syeda Maliha Tabassum, Md Rashad Al Hasan Rony
papers.evidence: 通过相机运动检验并辨别三维物理几何假设
papers.tldr: 走廊、镜面反射与屏幕图像可能在单张照片中几乎相同，但首个真实表面的深度不同，单凭外观容易误判。论文检验有限相机运动能否区分这些物理几何解释，提出Intervene3D：预测候选运动下各假设的视图，按最坏情形可分性选动作，并在证据不足时拒答或判定观测不适配。合成实验中，拒答避免对不可辨场景给出自信答案；已答场景准确率达100%，最大化最小可分性的策略覆盖61.0%。真实屏幕实验中，一次运动令12种深度网络的表面误差中位数降低31.5%，表明主动观察与审慎拒答能改善物理几何判断。
papers.abstract_en: A corridor, its mirror reflection, and its image on a display can look identical, yet their physical surfaces lie at different depths. We test whether bounded camera motions distinguish these explanations. Intervene3D takes an image and an initial geometry estimate, predicts the view under each hypothesis and candidate motion, and selects a motion by maximin separability. It reports the mechanism and first physical surface only if the available motions separate the hypotheses still in contention. Otherwise it abstains. An adequacy test also rejects observations that no hypothesis explains. On a matched synthetic benchmark with exact landmarks, disabling abstention gives confident answers on 76.4% of unresolvable scenes. With abstention, none receives a confident answer under exact or noisy landmarks. At 100% accuracy on answered scenes, maximin selection answers 61.0% of scenes and summed selection 43.1%. The adequacy test lowers wrong answers on strongly curved mirror scenes from 56.8% to 12.4%. Real display experiments compare two hypotheses using one frozen depth-network estimate. The second image supplies photometric evidence and is never passed through the depth network. One executed motion reduces the pooled median surface error of twelve networks by 31.5%. These networks have larger error inside the annotated panel than outside on 33.4% of illusion-benchmark images. They place the first physical surface behind the glass on 36.9% of Mirror3D frames.

papers.title_en: Do Deep Stereo Models Learn Shape Priors?
papers.authors: Linbo Tang, Aneel Damaraju, Todd Zickler
papers.evidence: 立体视觉联合估计视差与物体边界几何
papers.tldr: 立体视觉中的物体边界即使只有小幅偏差，也可能导致实体表面几何判断错误；当局部图像与视差线索不足时，模型能否依靠形状先验仍不清楚。研究构造形状族高度受限、深度与倾斜等因素随机变化的合成立体数据集，比较现有模型并提出联合预测视差和边界距离场的方法。实验发现，多种先进模型即使微调或从头训练仍有系统性边界误差，而新模型定位更准、轮廓更符合形状空间。结果揭示现有架构整合弱局部证据与全局几何结构的局限，并支持进一步探索生成式建模。
papers.abstract_en: Localizing object boundaries is important for embodied visual systems, since small boundary errors can change the inferred geometry of physical surfaces. We study whether deep stereo models produce boundaries consistent with simple shape priors when local image and disparity cues are weak. We create a synthetic stereo dataset consisting of objects drawn from a highly constrained family of shapes, with randomized depth, slant, color and texture. Despite the simplicity of this shape space, we find that several state-of-the-art stereo models retain systematic boundary errors, even when finetuned or trained from scratch on the dataset. We then introduce a simple generative stereo model that jointly predicts disparity and a distance field representing object boundaries. The model improves boundary localization and produces contours that adhere more closely to the underlying shape space. These results expose limitations in the boundary predictions of current stereo architectures when local evidence is weak, and motivate further study of whether generative models can better combine regional grouping evidence with global geometric structure.

papers.title_en: CoRelate: Coordinated Human-Object Motion Synthesis through Interaction Relations
papers.authors: Zhiwen Qiu, Daisy Lin, Diyu Zhou, Jialin Wu, Rosita Ji, Saleh Kalantari
papers.evidence: 显式建模人与物体接触关系以生成交互动作
papers.tldr: 人—物动作合成不仅要让物体到达指定目标，还需保证人体与物体建立并维持接触；改善接触的动作也不能妨碍任务完成。CoRelate为刚体和可动部件物体引入手部—物体部件关系，描述参与的手、相对参考位置及参与时段，并将其作为生成条件和交互评估依据。扩散去噪过程中，时序细化器结合关系偏差、任务残差与当前动作特征，联合更新人体和物体运动；生成后再局部修正接触失败，同时保护物体轨迹及指定的人体动作。实验表明，该方法提升物体目标满足度、接触F1和完整交互成功率，验证显式关系与任务反馈的互补价值。
papers.abstract_en: Human-object motion synthesis requires coordinated human participation as objects move toward specified goals. However, reaching object targets does not ensure that contact is established and maintained, while adjustments that improve contact may interfere with task completion. We introduce CoRelate, a diffusion framework that coordinates full-body human-object motion through explicit interaction relations and task feedback for rigid and articulated objects. We represent intended participation through hand-part relations that specify the participating hand, its part-relative reference position, and participation interval. These relations serve both as generation conditions and as references for measuring interaction realization. At each denoising step, a temporal refiner trained jointly with the generator combines relation deviations, task residuals, and motion features from the current prediction to jointly update human and object motion across the sequence. After generation, temporal motion correction addresses remaining contact failures by optimizing local motion segments while preserving object trajectories and protected human motion. Experiments demonstrate improved object-goal satisfaction, contact F1, and complete interaction success over the evaluated baselines. Ablation studies support the benefits of relation conditioning and the complementary roles of task and relation feedback.

papers.title_en: MS-Point: Multi-Modal Hierarchical Spectral Learning for Point Cloud Understanding
papers.authors: Hai-tao Yu, Jun Xia
papers.evidence: 利用编码器多层点特征和邻域响应进行跨模态层级学习
papers.tldr: 点云—图像对齐能学习有用的物体表示，但池化会抹去局部差异，使不同点特征模式得到相同描述和监督。MS-Point在编码器选定阶段直接监督中间点特征及其邻域响应，并以分支级图像对齐、跨层一致性和自适应融合协调多尺度信息。该框架兼容图网络和点云Transformer，在物体分类、少样本适配、稠密预测及低标签场景学习中展现迁移价值。对照实验进一步检验了监督结构的作用，说明显式学习中间特征与邻域变化有助于获得可迁移、具几何感知能力的跨模态表示。
papers.abstract_en: Point-image alignment learns useful object representations, but different local feature patterns can produce the same pooled descriptor and receive the same alignment signal. We introduce MS-Point, a cross-modal pretraining framework that directly supervises intermediate point features and their neighborhood responses. At selected encoder stages, we compute neighborhood averages and residuals before pooling and align their branch descriptors with image features. Branch-level objectives align each representation with its visual target, while cross-level consistency and adaptive fusion coordinate information across branches. A common interface of intermediate features and spatial neighborhoods supports both graph encoders and point Transformers. Evaluations across object classification, few-shot adaptation, dense prediction, and low-label scene learning demonstrate the transfer value of this design. Same-backbone comparisons and capacity-matched and computation-matched controls connect these improvements to the structure of supervision. Together, our findings support directly supervising intermediate features and neighborhood variation to learn transferable, geometry-aware representations across modalities.

papers.title_en: MIR-Depth: Multi-Range Refinement for Single-View RGB-D Depth Completion of Transparent Objects
papers.authors: Xinzhe Fu, Qi Shao, Yuanfei Xie, Taoyu Wu, Zhihao Cao, Long Hu, Hong Liang, Xianzhi Li, Anh Nguyen, Baoru Huang, Rongsheng Li
papers.evidence: 补全透明物体可见表面深度，服务于机器人抓取与操作
papers.tldr: 透明物体的反射会导致深度缺失，折射还会使传感器返回背景深度，单张彩色与深度图中的原始测量因而难以作为可靠表面锚点。单一搜索区间又难以同时覆盖大幅折射偏移和精细局部调整。MIR-Depth构建全局及逐像素局部多范围逆深度假设，并以选择性循环细化和空间门控修正预测。实验在五个数据集上优于多种已有方法，真实机器人测试也验证了其对六自由度抓取姿态预测的支持。该方法为透明物体可见表面深度恢复提供了更准确的方案。
papers.abstract_en: Recovering accurate visible-surface depth from a single RGB-D image and an object mask is essential for robotic grasping and manipulation of transparent objects. Specular reflections cause missing depth, while refraction corrupts nonzero returns with background depth, making raw measurements unreliable as surface anchors. Under a fixed sampling budget, refining an initial single-view prediction within a single search interval either misses large refraction offsets or sacrifices fine local resolution. To resolve this single-view trade-off, MIR-Depth constructs Coordinate-Aware Multi-Range Hypotheses: a 3D-aggregated global inverse-depth volume and depth-axis-filtered pixel-wise local volumes around a prior-guided initial depth. Selective Recurrent Refinement then introduces out-of-bounds lookup masking and validity-masked softmax fusion to iteratively update inverse depth from these volumes using a multi-scale ConvGRU. Finally, Spatially Gated Correction applies a learned per-pixel spatial gate to the full-resolution residual, preserving accurate initial geometry without imposing raw sensor readings as hard constraints. Experiments on TransCG, TODD, TRansPose, ClearPose, and HouseCat6D show that MIR-Depth achieves lower error than ReMake, DFNet, BP-Net, and PSD. Real-robot evaluations confirm accurate surface geometry for 6-DoF grasp pose prediction. Code and pretrained models will be publicly available.

papers.title_en: LoongForge-Embodied: A Unified Framework for Training Heterogeneous Embodied Models
papers.authors: LoongForge Team
papers.evidence: 面向视觉语言动作及世界动作具身模型的统一训练框架
papers.tldr: VLA 与 WAM 训练计算开销大，架构和训练栈分散，导致优化难以复用，评测也较低效。LoongForge-Embodied 以原生 PyTorch 构建统一抽象层，在不限制模型架构的前提下复用训练基础设施，并按模型与硬件特点优化计算、内存、数据读写和分布式通信。框架还整合机器人数据合成与高效并发评测。实验中训练吞吐提升 1.47 至 4.38 倍，评测提速 4.1 至 23.2 倍，为异构具身模型提供统一、高效的训练评测方案。
papers.abstract_en: Training Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models and World-Action Models (WAMs) is computationally expensive, while their heterogeneous architectures and fragmented training stacks make system optimizations difficult to reuse across models. To address these challenges, we present LoongForge-Embodied, a native-PyTorch framework that unifies and accelerates the training of heterogeneous embodied models. At its core, LoongForge-Embodied introduces a common abstraction layer that decouples model-specific implementations from shared training infrastructure, enabling cross-model reuse without constraining individual architectures or execution requirements. Buildingon this unified infrastructure, the framework combines reusable acceleration mechanisms with model-specific and hardware-aware optimization strategies across computation, execution, memory, data I/O, and distributed communication, including FP8-based communication optimizations for DDP and FSDP. Beyond training acceleration, LoongForge-Embodied integrates a unified data infrastructure with a pipeline for synthesizing robot data from egocentric data, and an efficient evaluation framework that supports concurrency and optimized computation in simulator. Experiments across representative VLA and WAM models demonstrate 1.47x-4.38x end-to-end training throughput improvements over their corresponding open-source baselines, as well as 4.1x-23.2x faster evaluation under the same protocols.
